events.label: grounding
events.text: Ship grounded near Holmsund; tanks damaged, sailed to Helsinki for repairs.

evidence.quote: On 14 February 1981 the ship was grounded near Holmsund

events.label: repair
events.text: Continued from Helsinki to Kiel, where final repairs were done at Howaldtswerke.

evidence.quote: February 1981 the Wasa Star continued from Helsinki to Kiel , Germany where she was finally repaired at Howaldtswerke-Deutsche Werft

events.text: Delivered to Rederi AB Gotland, planned name MS Gotland.

evidence.quote: was delivered on 24 June 1981 to Rederi Ab Gotland

events.text: Chartered to Vaasanlaivat / Vasabåtarna of Finland one day after delivery.

evidence.quote: on one day following her delivery the ship was chartered to Vaasanlaivat / Vasabåtarna , Finland and officially named MS Wasa Star

events.text: Officially named MS Wasa Star one day after delivery.

evidence.quote: on one day following her delivery the ship was chartered to Vaasanlaivat / Vasabåtarna , Finland and officially named MS Wasa Star

events.text: Began service on the Vaasa to Sundsvall route, largest Kvarken ferry then.

evidence.quote: On 1 July 1981 the brand new Wasa Star started traffic on the route connecting Vaasa in Finland to Sundsvall in Sweden

events.text: Moved to the Vaasa to Umeå route.

evidence.quote: In February 1982 the ship was moved to the Vaasa – Umeå route

events.text: Returned to the Vaasa to Sundsvall route.

evidence.quote: On 1 April 1982 the Wasa Star returned to the Vaasa – Sundsvall route

events.label: laid_up
events.text: Taken out of traffic and laid up in Sundsvall due to unprofitability.

evidence.quote: on 31 August 1982 she was taken out of traffic and laid up in Sundsvall

events.text: Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered the ship to Karageorgios Line, Greece.

evidence.quote: There she remained until May 1983 , when Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered her to Karageorgios Line , Greece

events.text: Left Sundsvall for Valletta, Malta to prepare for Mediterranean service.

evidence.quote: she left Sundsvall for Valletta , Malta where she was docked in preparation for her new service

events.text: Started Patras to Ancona route service with weekly Igoumenitsa trip.

evidence.quote: In June she started trafficking on a route connecting Patras , Greece to Ancona , Italy

events.text: Sold to Norwegian operator Larvik Line after charter disputes resolved.

evidence.quote: On 29 August 1983 , after the various conflicting charter agreements were resolved , the Wasa Star was sold to the Norwegian operator Larvik Line

events.text: Left Landskrona, Sweden after laid-up period, bound for Larvik Line.

evidence.quote: She left Landskrona on 13 January 1984

events.text: Renamed MS Peter Wessel after Peter Wessel Tordenskiold.

evidence.quote: In March of the same year she was renamed MS Peter Wessel

events.text: Started operating on the Larvik to Frederikshavn route.

evidence.quote: started operating on the Larvik–Frederikshavn route

events.label: collision
events.text: Collided with MS Sydfjord, which sank; crew evacuated aboard Peter Wessel.

evidence.quote: The Peter Wessel collided with MS Sydfjord on 27 June 1986

events.text: Lengthened at Blohm + Voss, Hamburg; additional cabins built on top.

evidence.quote: Peter Wessel was extended by meters at Blohm + Voss , Hamburg , Germany in 1988

events.text: Color Line chartered Peter Wessel from Larvik Line.

evidence.quote: In October 1996 Color Line chartered the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line

events.text: Parts of the car deck rebuilt with cabins, reducing car capacity.

evidence.quote: In 1999 parts of the cardeck were built in with cabins

events.text: Rebuilt at Remontowa, Poland with large side sponsons for stability.

evidence.quote: In spring 2003 the ship was rebuilt again , this time at Remontowa , Poland

events.text: Color Line bought Peter Wessel from Larvik Line.

evidence.quote: In 2004 Color Line bought the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line

events.text: Transferred to the Larvik to Hirtshals route.

evidence.quote: In April 2006 the ship was transferred to the Larvik—Hirtshals route

events.label: fire
events.text: Fire in electric switchboard forced diversion to Frederikshavn.

evidence.quote: On 22 March 2007 a fire broke out in one of the ships electric switchboards

events.text: Returned to service after over a month of repairs.

evidence.quote: returning to service on 26 April 2007

events.text: Color Line announced sale of Peter Wessel to Mediterranean Shipping Company.

evidence.quote: On 19 October 2007 Color Line reported that the Peter Wessel has been sold to Mediterranean Shipping Company

events.text: Entered service on SNAV Civitavecchia routes to Palermo or Olbia.

evidence.quote: She entered service on SNAVs Civitavecchia—Palermo or Civitavecchia – Olbia service during 2008

events.text: Delivered to new owners, Mediterranean Shipping Company.

evidence.quote: The Peter Wessel was delivered to her new owners on 16 April 2008

events.text: Subsequently renamed MS SNAV Toscana after delivery.

evidence.quote: The Peter Wessel was delivered to her new owners on 16 April 2008 and subsequently renamed MS SNAV Toscana

events.text: SNAV Toscana left Norway for the Mediterranean.

evidence.quote: On 19 April 2008 the SNAV Toscana left Norway for the Mediterranean

events.text: Renamed GNV Azzurra.

evidence.quote: Since 2017 , SNAV Toscana was renamed as GNV Azzurra

undated_mentions: Rederi AB Gotland ordered two large ferries from Öresundsvarvet after Swedish PM persuasion (late 1970s)
Sailed to Helsinki for repairs after grounding (no date given)
Sailed to Landskrona to be laid up after payment dispute ended Mediterranean charter (no exact date)
